title_en: APARTMENT 1+1 FOR SALE IN UNIVERS CITY WITH PARK VIEW!
description_en: The apartment is located in one of the buildings that has a full view of the park of the Univer City complex, located on the 3rd floor of a building with 6 residential floors and a service unit floor. Plastering phase, Finished in October 2025. Organized by - Living room + kitchen area - 1 Bedroom - 1 Toilet - 1 Balcony Regular layout with south orientation. The apartment also has a parking space on the -1st floor with an extra price (17,000) euros
